question: Which of the following cities is closest to the location of Pushkar Fair?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajmer**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pushkar Fair-**

 
 
• It is a **famous pilgrimage site** of Hindus **located 11 km away from Ajmer.**
 
• Pushkar Fair is an annual multi-day livestock fair and cultural festival held in the city of Pushkar (Rajasthan, India).
 
• The fair begins on the Hindu calendar month of Kartik and ends on Kartik Poornima, which usually occurs in late October and early November in the Gregorian calendar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amravati -**

 
 
• It is a town in the Amravati District of Maharashtra State.
 
• The** 'Bahiram Fair' **of Amravati district is famous.
 
 
 
• **Ahmedabad -**
 
 
• It is a** famous big city **in Gujarat state.
 
• It is also known as** 'Manchester of India'.**
 
 
 
• **Prayagraj -**
 
 
• This place is situated at the confluence of the** Ganges, Yamuna and Saraswati rivers**. Hence it is called **'Triveni Sangam'.**
 
• **Kumbh Mela **is held here **every twelve years**, and Ardh Kumbh Mela is organized every six years.
